trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods (OECD via FRED, converted to Danish kroner at each period's own exchange rate)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, QoQ (derived from CLVMNACSCAB1GQDK)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence indicator, LT avg = 100 (OECD BCICP)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, YoY (OECD live prices system)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (Eurostat)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (Eurostat)
